content: Wolqqaama Anjjuwaa
Hewaa diraw, nuuni siseedda tumu yewuwaappe sugetti wora beenna mala, he yewuwaa loythi oyqqanaw bessee.
Ayissi gooppe, kiitanchchatuu odeedda qaalay tuma gidiyaa diraw, naaqqiyaa woy azazettenna asay ubbay muretteeddawaa gidooppe,
Yaatina, nuuni ha wolqqaama atotethaa sheneko gooppe, waaniide attanee? Goday koyro bare huuphew ha atotethaa odeedda; qassi I odeeddawaa siseeddawanttu nuussi geeshshiide odeeddino.

He siseeddawanttu markkatteeddawe bolla Xoossaykka mallaa, oorathabaanne dumma dumma malaata kiitettiyaawan gujji markkatteedda; qassi Geeshsha Ayyaanaa imuwaakka bare koyyeeddawaadan, gishi gatheedda.
Atotethaw Kaalethiyaawaa
Ayissi gooppe, Xoossay nuuni haasayiyaa sinthaappe yaana alamiyaa, kiitanchchatuwa moodissibeenna.
Shin Xoossaa Maxaafay itti saan hawaadan yaagee;

content.text: Woy neeni aw hirgganaw I ayee?

content: yaagee. Ayissi gooppe, Xoossay ubbabaakka A moodisseeddawaadan aani moodettibeennawe ayaynne baawa; shin ha77i ubbabay aw moodettiyaawe nuussi beettenna.

Shin nuuni Yesuusa be7eetto; Yesuusi Xoossaa aadho keekatethaa bagganna asa ubbaw hayqqana mala, amareedda wodiyaa kiitanchchatuwappe garssa gideedda. Qassi hayquwaa waayyiyaa I waayyetteedda diraw, poo7iya bonchchuwaanne sabaa akililiyaa wotheeddawaa ha77i nuuni be7eetto.

Xoossay ubbabaa medhdheeddawe, ubbabaakka naagiyawe, Yesuusi daro naanaa ahiide, barenanna bonchchissana mala, waayyiyaa bagganna Yesuusa balay baynnawaa ootheeddawaa bessee; ayissi gooppe, he naanaa atotethaw kaalethiyaawe Yesuusa.
Ayissi gooppe, asaa geeshshiyaa Yesuusawukka qassi he geeyyeedda asaa ubbawukka Aawuu ittuwa. Yesuusi unttuntta, “Ta ishatuwaa” giide yeellatennaan xeesiyaawe hawaassa.
Yesuusi,
yaagee.
Qassi I, “Taani ta ammanuwaa Xoossaan wothana” qassikka, “Xoossay taw immeedda naanatuwaanna taani hawaan de7ay” yaagee.

Naanaa giide I xeesiyaawanttu, ashuwaappenne suuthaappe medhetteedda asatuwaa gidiyaa diraw, Yesuusi bare huuphew unttuntta malatiide, unttunttu medhetaa akkeedda; qassi I hewaa ootheeddawe, xalahiyaa kaappuwaa hayquwaa bolla maatay de7iyaawaa bare hayquwan dhayissanaassa.
Qassi barenttu de7uwaa ubbaan hayqoo yayyiide, hayqoo aylletiide de7iyaawantta ubbatuwaa aylletethaappe kesseedda.
Ayissi gooppe, Abraahaama zariyaa I maaddiyawaappe attin, kiitanchchatuwa maaddennawe eretteedda.
Hewaa diraw, asaa nagaray atto geetettana mala, Xoossaa kiitaan ammanetteedda maariyaa qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa gidana mala, ubbabaani I bare ishatuwaa malatanaw bessee.
Ayissi gooppe, I bare huuphew paacetteedda dirawunne waayyetteedda diraw, paacettiyaawantta maaddanaw danddayee.
